responsive.layout: On mobile screen (<768px), sidebar panels convert into bottom sheets or collapsible modals so the satellite map remains fully interactable. Action buttons in the bottom dock have both icon and concise Italian text with horizontal scroll overflow.
responsive.typography: Mobile-first type scale with responsive headings (text-lg to text-2xl), body text at 14px to prevent iOS auto-zoom on inputs.
responsive.overflow_guard: Map container is locked to w-full h-[100dvh] overflow-hidden with touch-action: pan-x pan-y pinch-zoom. Side drawers and bottom sheets use internal scroll-areas with overflow-y-auto and overflow-x-hidden.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 44x44px touch bounding box for every toolbar button, vertex handle, azimuth compass notch, and accordion header.

map_container.engine: Leaflet.js with react-leaflet or vanilla leaflet integration
map_container.state_controls: Touch vertex drag, undo last point, live perimeter and area readout in m² / Ettari

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete Progetto Oliveto application inside `/app/frontend` using React (with .jsx / .js files), Tailwind CSS, Leaflet / react-leaflet, and shadcn/ui components.
Implement the full Italian interface. All button texts, field names, tooltips, units of measurement, and error toasts MUST be in natural, professional Italian agricultural agronomy terminology.

Ensure the map starts empty with NO preloaded demo fields as requested by user choices, but provide a convenient 'Localizza la mia azienda / GPS' or quick-preset Italian olive regions (Puglia, Toscana, Sicilia, Garda) to jump coordinates rapidly.
Implement the bottom touch toolbar with high-contrast icon + Italian label (Nuovo Campo, Annulla Ultimo Punto, Chiudi/Salva Campo, Aggiungi Ostacolo, Elimina Confine, Sposta Mappa, GPS Posizione).
Support full touch interaction on mobile devices with vertex placement, dragging, undoing last point, and polygon closing.
Geometric engine for olive row calculation: Clip parallel line segments against the polygon boundary minus headland margins (capezzagne di testata e laterali) and minus obstacle buffer polygons.

Implement the interactive Azimuth Compass: Allow fine rotation (1°) via knob/slider and provide both 'Scansione Veloce (5°)' and 'Scansione Fine (1°)' auto-optimization algorithms that find the orientation yielding maximum tree density or longest continuous rows.

Implement the Drip Irrigation calculator: compute total drip tubing meters, number of emitters, required flow rate (m³/h), sector zoning (1 to 4 valves), pipe diameter recommendations, and pressure metrics.
Provide multi-field management with a slide-out drawer: create, rename, switch between multiple fields, save to MongoDB backend via FastAPI with seamless local fallback/offline tolerance.

Support complete exports: Client-side PDF technical report generator (using jspdf / html2canvas or styled printable view), GeoJSON export with all geometry layers, and CSV plant-by-plant bill of materials.
Ensure mobile-first responsiveness: On smartphone screens (<768px), floating drawers smoothly convert into bottom sliding sheets (Vaul or shadcn Sheet) so the map remains viewable and uncluttered.
CRITICAL: Always assign explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, map controls, and report values for automated testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not build a generic template. Craft a tactile, military/agronomic grade GIS instrument with deep obsidian and olive slate surfaces, neon-emerald geometry highlights, and crisp monospaced telemetry figures.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_gradients_over_saturation: Avoid heavy saturated gradients. Use subtle dark glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-stone-950/85), 1px micro-borders (border-stone-800/80), and razor-sharp contrast.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_integrity: Never leave transparent backgrounds on menus, popovers, or floating toolbars. Maintain APCA legible high contrast for bright daylight outdoor field usage.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.strict_test_ids: Every button, slider, tab trigger, and export action must have unambiguous data-testid attributes like 'btn-new-field', 'input-interrow-distance', 'compass-azimuth-slider', 'btn-export-pdf'.
